extracted.intended_audience: USPTO examiners, patent practitioners (attorneys/agents), and patent applicants
extracted.subtask_description: A summary of revisions (Revision 01.2024, Nov 2024) to the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) describing updated legal and procedural standards for patent prosecution, examination, and related USPTO processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim of foreign priority entitlement
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify when the examiner considers the subject matter of a foreign priority document for determining whether an applicant is entitled to a claim of priority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updated to clarify the circumstances under which subject matter in a foreign priority document may be considered for entitlement to a priority claim (see Chapter 200 changes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent electronic filing system status & receipt timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated process for viewing status inquiries in the USPTO patent electronic filing system and clarified when correspondence submitted via the Patent Center is accorded a receipt date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replaced references to EFS-Web/PAIR with 'USPTO patent electronic filing system' or Patent Center and updated guidance about when filings receive a receipt date and how filing receipts now reflect art unit (if available) rather than suggested class.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment record integrity for expungement petitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify which information in assignment records is considered to affect the integrity of the assignment record when petitioning to expunge information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information other than personally identifiable information can be considered to affect assignment record integrity; updated handling procedures for documents in Assignment Recordation Branch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design patent practitioner bar and representation limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the new design patent practitioner bar and limitations on representation and interview practice when acting in a representative capacity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporates Representation of Others in Design Patent Matters rule changes; design patent practitioners acting in representative capacity may only do so in design patent matters; clarifies Customer Number practice and limitations on conducting interviews when representing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee reductions and non-DOCX (non-electronic) filing surcharge
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated guidance on fee reductions established by the Unleashing American Innovators Act of 2022 and treatment of the non-DOCX filing surcharge in fee determinations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updated small and micro entity fee percentages, added non-DOCX fee discussion, added SB/460 form for Notification of Loss of Micro Entity Status, and clarified order in which payments are applied when insufficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant-suggested drawing figure in publication
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporation of guidance from Applicant-Suggested Drawing Figure in the Publication of Patent Applications (OG notice).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updated sections (e.g., Chapter 600, 1100) to include rules on applicant-suggested drawing figures for publication and related ADS handling (corrected ADS after filing date).

rubrics_metrics.name: Color photograph storage and publication rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated how color photographs are stored and published and reminder that all issued utility patents are presented with black and white drawings/photographs in USPTO search systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains storage in content management system, placement of black and white copies in file wrapper, and potential notifications when gray backgrounds reduce reproduction quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Propriety of final grounds of rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarified guidance on the propriety of making final grounds of rejection and when a second/subsequent action on the merits will not be made final.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updates include references to cross sections (e.g., MPEP § 904.02) and examples; clarifies when an office action may be final or prematurely final and examiner annotation procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of multiple dependent claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarified treatment of multiple dependent claims and instruction to treat each version separately in Office actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Added guidance and cross references (MPEP § 608.01(n)); cites Nested Bean decision; clarifies that each version of a multiple dependent claim is treated separately for Office actions and fee determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interview practice and interview summaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated guidance on scheduling, conducting, and documenting examiner interviews (including Applicant Initiated Interview Request Form PTOL-413A).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies interview formats, when interviews should be conducted on campus, how applicants/representatives receive Interview Summary form copies, and authorization for registered practitioners to conduct interviews when acting in representative capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secondary considerations and commercial success/nexus burden
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarified burden of production for evidence of commercial success and nexus and who bears the burden in establishing nexus for secondary considerations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revises titles and guidance (e.g., 'BURDEN OF PRODUCTION FOR EVIDENCE OF COMMERCIAL SUCCESS AND NEXUS'), removes some discussions of nexus, cites cases (In re Huang, UCB v. Actavis), and clarifies who must show nexus and the standard for attributing commercial success to the claimed invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: WIPO standards adoption (ST.9, ST.26, ST.80) and sequence listing requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Updates to reflect adoption of updated WIPO standards (ST.9, ST.26, ST.80) and related Sequence Listing XML requirements and validators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes new 'Helpful Hints for Sequence Rules Compliance', description of Sequence Validator and WIPO sequence tool, 1GB threshold and style-sheet conversion to ASCII for US presentation, and Editor Notes on applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign patent/publication access & STIC services procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated sources and procedures for examiners to obtain foreign patents, use of Foreign Image and Text (FIT) database, machine/human translations, and STIC/Library processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replaces legacy search systems guidance (EAST/WEST), updates STIC Library addresses, online catalogs, available languages for oral translations, and processes for requesting materials and litigation/patent family searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation of petition decision authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Added cross references to clarify delegations of authority to decide certain petitions and which office/unit decides petitions (e.g., Central Reexamination Unit, Director of International Patent Legal Administration).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates which petitions are decided by which USPTO unit and adds cross references to MPEP sections clarifying petition routing and decision authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preissuance third-party submissions timing (37 CFR 1.290(b)(2)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarified guidance which publications will and will not trigger the 37 CFR 1.290(b)(2)(i) time period for preissuance submissions by third parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aligns with prior rule changes and clarifies which publications start the statutory time window for third-party submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PTAB oral hearing procedures and pre-appeal handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporated PTAB Oral Hearing Guide, added reference to PTAB pro bono program, and clarified handling procedures for Pre-Appeal Brief Conference Requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updates cross references and internal procedures to align MPEP guidance with PTAB practices and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Assurance review references
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarified cross references and guidance for examiner review of applications under the Quality Assurance program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adds references in Chapter 1300 for QA program review and clarifies expectations for examiner conduct in QA reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to defer issuance & withdrawing/deferring issue
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated discussion of petitions to defer issuance of patent and procedures for withdrawing an application from issue, including timeline changes due to eGrants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how electronic patent grants and eGrants affect timeline from issue fee payment to patent issue and best practices for filing continuing applications before paying issue fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificates of correction and electronic issuance
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporated procedures for electronic issuance of certificates of correction and transition to electronic certificates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reflects USPTO's transition to issuing electronic certificates of correction and updates related MPEP guidance and citations (e.g., issuance procedures and cross references).

rubrics_metrics.name: Design patent guidance for computer-generated electronic images and claim shifting
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporated guidance on computer-generated electronic images (icons, GUIs) and clarified when an examiner may permit claimed inventions to be shifted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References Supplemental Guidance for Examination of Design Patent Applications Related to Computer-Generated Electronic Images and clarifies examiner allowances for shifting claimed inventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plant patent examination guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorporated updated guidance previously published on the USPTO’s Plant Patent webpage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chapter 1600 revised to include the updated plant patent guidance and cross references.

rubrics_metrics.name: National stage applications: fees and lack of unity
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarified application of fees in national stage applications and practice surrounding lack of unity requirements in national stage filings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes removal of references to Rospatent, clarification of fee application rules, and guidance on lack of unity responses and challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive patentability doctrines (inventorship, claim interpretation, 35 U.S.C. 102/103/112)
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated case law and guidance on inventorship, claim interpretation, anticipation under 35 U.S.C. 102, obviousness under 35 U.S.C. 103, written description, enablement, and definiteness requirements under 35 U.S.C. 112.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chapter 2100 updated to include recent case law and to clarify prior art exceptions under AIA 35 U.S.C. 102(b) and updated enablement guidance consistent with Amgen v. Sanofi.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enablement assessment guidance (post-Amgen v. Sanofi)
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated guidance on the enablement requirement consistent with Guidelines for Assessing Enablement in Utility Applications and Patents in view of Amgen Inc. v. Sanofi.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adds references to the Federal Register guidance and revises MPEP text to reflect the Supreme Court decision's impact on enablement assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplies/copies of cited prior art in 35 U.S.C. 301 submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Correction on supplying copies of cited prior art patents and publications in 35 U.S.C. 301 submissions and modernization of example letters for submitting prior art under 37 CFR 1.501.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Makes prior guidance consistent with first-inventor-to-file regime and updates sample letters and procedures for submitting prior art citations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to accept delayed priority or benefit claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Reiterated that petitions to accept delayed priority or benefit claims filed more than two years after the foreign priority or benefit claim was due require additional explanation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies petition requirements and additional explanations necessary for late claims to priority or benefit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inter partes reexamination cessation and ex parte reexamination cross-refs
rubrics_metrics.description: Removed most guidance regarding inter partes reexamination because the Office no longer accepts such requests after Sep 16, 2012; cross-references to earlier MPEP publications retained for historical practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains that ex parte reexamination remains available and redirects readers to MPEP sections covering former inter partes practices for historical reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent term adjustment (PTA) statements and electronic filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Revisions to standardization of the PTA statement regarding Information Disclosure Statements and requirements for filing 37 CFR 1.704(d) statements, including electronic filing and timing changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updates Editor Notes, reproduced regulatory text (37 CFR 1.704), and provides new paragraphs describing filing procedures on/after July 17, 2023 (and 37 CFR 1.704(d)(3)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance fee payment process & petition for unintentionally delayed payment
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated maintenance fee payment information in light of EFS-Web retirement and revised the process for petitioning to accept unintentionally delayed payment of a maintenance fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies internet payment options, replaces Private PAIR references, and updates cross references to Customer Service Window and new forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: IDS/eIDS electronic submission and eIDS naming conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Revised terminology and guidance for Information Disclosure Statements submitted electronically using Patent Center (eIDS) and updated form paragraphs related to IDS processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replaces 'e-IDS' with 'eIDS', updates form paragraphs, clarifies title changes (e.g., 'IDSs Electronically Submitted (eIDS) Using Patent Center'), and addresses sequence listing XML filing mechanics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence listing compliance and helpful hints
rubrics_metrics.description: Added 'Helpful Hints for Sequence Rules Compliance under WIPO Standard ST.26' and clarified Sequence Listing XML requirements, transformation to ASCII, and validator tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains WIPO ST.26 applicability, US style sheet conversion for XML <1GB to ASCII, use of WIPO sequence tool/Sequence Validator, and updated form paragraphs for sequence-related submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental examination filing and 'follow-on' paper procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarified who can electronically file a supplemental examination request and how corrected requests and papers in resulting reexamination proceedings should be filed as 'follow-on' papers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updates flowcharts referencing PAIR to Patent Center, clarifies filing user guides and document descriptions, and recommends including Mail Stop information on first page of papers.

rubrics_metrics.name: International design application procedures (Hague) and reproductions
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated benefits and procedures for filing an international design application with WIPO (eHague), instructions for submitting reproductions, and conforming Hague Rule cross references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes electronic filing guidance through USPTO as office of indirect filing, updates to Hague Rule 14 references and submission processes in light of EFS-Web retirement, and application number formats for WIPO DAS retrieval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form paragraph and FPC consolidation guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter FPC consolidates form paragraphs reproduced in numbered chapters of the MPEP and indicates which form paragraphs were revised, deleted, or added in this MPEP revision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should consult the Subject Matter Index to locate reproduced form paragraphs in the MPEP; FPC sections organized by form paragraph number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement of legacy system names and gender-neutral language updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Replaced references to legacy search systems (EAST/WEST) with PE2E-Search or Patent Center, replaced Assignment Division/Branch names with Assignment Recordation Branch, and revised language to be gender-neutral where appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies across revised sections; also replaces internal system names like PALM with Patent Data Portal and updates URLs and references accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures for making classification challenges in CPC after an election
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarified the procedure for making classification challenges in CPC after an election and added cross references to relevant MPEP sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updated discussion of Office of Patent Classification Home Page and removed references to obsolete classification retrieval systems; provides procedural references to MPEP § 812 and others.
